Workshop ticket 0419

Our 30-point workshop check: passed, and every point signed off on the ticket, which comes with the bike. Tested: Battery health 88%.

Battery health is our capacity test result as a share of the battery's rated capacity (the watt-hours on its label). Range also depends on the rider, the route, the weather and the assist level, so it isn't a range promise. Like every e-bike we sell, it meets the UK rules for an electrically assisted pedal cycle: motor rated at no more than 250W, and assistance cuts out at 15.5 mph. Riders must be 14 or over.

Collection or delivery

Collect it from the workshop for free and we'll set the saddle height with you. E-bikes go by a specialist courier, because Royal Mail and Parcelforce don't carry them: £[e-bike delivery price].

Warranty and your rights

3-month warranty on the whole bike, parts and labour, from the day you collect it or it's delivered. It's on top of your Consumer Rights Act 2015 rights, not instead of them.

You can also cancel for any reason within 14 days, starting the day after you get the bike (Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013). Returning it is at your cost: bring it back to the workshop, or we collect it for £39 (e-bikes £[e-bike collection price]).
